# TITMAS

> Trusted Multi-Agent Infrastructure
> 可信多智能体基础设施

TITMAS provides open, agent-readable trust infrastructure for long-running
multi-agent systems. The current public artifact is a bounded Developer Preview,
not an Agent Framework, Runtime, hosted API, permission system, certification,
or production release.

## Start here

- Commercial evaluation package:
  ./TITMAS-COMMERCIAL-EVALUATION-PACK-v0.2.json
- External agent first-run validation:
  ./TITMAS-EXTERNAL-AGENT-FIRST-RUN-VALIDATION-REPORT-v0.1.md
- Ten-minute first run:
  ./TITMAS-FIRST-RUN-v0.1.md
- Synthetic validation fixture:
  ./examples/titmas-first-run/entity-object.synthetic.v0.1.json
- Public package manifest:
  ./DBOS-PUBLIC-PACKAGE-MANIFEST-v0.1.json
- Agent customer package:
  ./AGENT-CUSTOMER-PACKAGE-v0.1.1.json
- Public project overview:
  ./PUBLIC-PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md

## Install

Python requirement: >=3.11

git clone --branch codex/production-observability-baseline --single-branch https://github.com/joy7758/digital-biosphere-architecture-specification.git
cd digital-biosphere-architecture-specification
python3 -m venv .venv-titmas
. .venv-titmas/bin/activate
python3 -m pip install https://github.com/joy7758/digital-biosphere-architecture-specification/releases/download/v0.1-developer-preview/digital_biosphere_os_preview-0.1.0.dev0-py3-none-any.whl

## Validate

dbos-validate examples/titmas-first-run/entity-object.synthetic.v0.1.json

Expected result: PASS

PASS means local structure and governance-constraint validation only. It does
not establish truth, authority, authorization, permission, certification,
registration, activation, execution, or production readiness.
